newsitem.title: USA: U.S. condemns arrest of dissidents in Cuba.
newsitem.headline: U.S. condemns arrest of dissidents in Cuba.

text.p: The United States on Thursday denounced the arrest of four dissidents in Cuba and called on the communist government in Havana to release them.
The Cuban government said the four were being investigated on suspicion of "counter-revolutionary" activities.
"We strongly condemn the arrests and we call on the Cuban government to release these dissidents," State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns said.

"These are political activists who don't agree with the views of the Cuban government, and it seems to us that they're being arrested simply because they hold different views than the Cuban government," Burns told reporters.
He said such arrests were contrary to the Universal Declaration on Human Rights.
The four people detained early on Wednesday at their Havana homes are Vladimiro Roca, Martha Beatriz Roque, Felix Bonne and Rene Gomez Manzano.

The four run a group called the "Working Group of Internal Dissidence," that says it has the support of 14 other small dissident organisations in Cuba and is seeking to forge some unity among Cuba's small and fragmented opposition.
